description:
Review point 2 (Medium): https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/956#discussion_r4684535245

Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/{notification_smtp_live,notification_imap_live,web_widget_live}.ex currently turn lookup failures into %{}; open_capabilities only toggles visibility. Preserve a distinct failure state, render "Capabilities unavailable", and retry on open only after a failed lookup. A successful empty result must remain distinguishable from failure. Preserve cached successful snapshots. Reuse lib/zaq_web/components/channel_capabilities.ex and the three existing .html.heex call sites; add an explicit backward-compatible error input if appropriate rather than copying modal markup.

Dependency: Implement after review point 3. Widget mount must consume the normalized result from the shared settings snapshot. Retry must not reset connector selection, unsaved form values, installation state, or secrets by indiscriminately calling reload/apply_snapshot; use the established provider-scoped event for a focused retry, or an equally narrow existing boundary.

Tests to add before implementation: In test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/{notification_smtp_live,notification_imap_live,web_widget_live}_test.exs, reproduce mount failure, failed open, recovery on subsequent open, and successful cached reopen without another lookup. Preserve zero/multiple connector cases. Add component tests in test/zaq_web/components/channel_capabilities_test.exs for unavailable vs successful-empty vs populated states and compatibility with existing callers.

Branches/paths: initial failure; repeated failure; recovery; cached success; empty success; widget form state during retry. Mocking: keep internal domain boundaries real; use existing NodeRouter/test infrastructure and isolated configuration. If deterministic dispatch failure requires an internal stub, document the hard technical constraint per testing handbook; no global runtime mutation without isolation.

Documentation: Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before UI work, docs/services/channels.md and docs/services/engine.md for boundaries, and docs/documentation.md before prose edits. Update relevant capability behavior docs only where needed. New browser E2E is unnecessary for this correction because component/LiveView tests exercise the full event and rendering paths; reassess if that proves insufficient.

Action reuse assessment: Reuse Channels.Api :channel_capability_snapshot via Event/NodeRouter, extend existing LiveView state and shared ChannelCapabilities presentation. Widget initialization reuses point 3's Engine settings result. This is local UI lifecycle/error state around an existing query, not a new composable operation. Inputs remain provider and provider scope; preserve actor context; errors remain distinct from data; retry is read-only and success stays cached. No new Action, agent tool, workflow step or direct cross-service call.

Acceptance: All three pages show the failure message and recover on reopen; no blank failure modal, duplicate widget mount query, successful-path refetch, or lost form state.

Agent instructions: Fix this issue on the PR #956 lineage after rechecking live code and review state. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before implementation. Use Serena for code understanding and Context Mode for operational analysis. Read module docs before adding functions. Follow the existing-test-behavior approval gate: add regression tests without changing existing assertions/scenarios; if a change is necessary, disclose the old/new contract and obtain explicit approval first. Keep changes scoped; do not commit, push, merge, reply to reviews, or resolve threads without authorization. Record validation and blockers in this issue. Follow the workflow validation lifecycle; preserve the prior instruction recorded in PR #956 that mix precommit was stopped and not to restart it unless superseded by the user.

comments.text: Action reuse confirmed: use existing provider-scoped Channels event through NodeRouter; widget initialization consumes zaq-vfx.3 settings result. Retry changes only capability/error/modal assigns and does not invoke reload/apply_snapshot. Shared ChannelCapabilities gains an optional error flag, preserving existing callers and successful-empty semantics. New tests use real Engine/Channels boundaries; missing provider bridge deterministically fails the real lookup, restored on exit in existing synchronous modules. Erlang call-count observation verifies cache/query contracts without production hooks or internal stubs.

Implemented explicit failure presentation in the existing shared component and narrow retries in SMTP/IMAP/widget open handlers. Successful empty snapshots remain cached. Red run reproduced missing failure messages and non-recovering widget retry; fixed the new failure-socket scaffold. Green: mix q passed; six isolated Engine/component/LiveView files passed 159 checks (1 property, 158 tests). Real-domain regressions cover initial/repeated failure, recovery, cached reopen, zero/two widgets, draft/selection preservation and focused installation/one-time-key state. Existing tests unchanged. Final diff review and applicable validation assessment remain in progress.

Diff review: error flag is optional/backward-compatible; existing component callers and Storybook keep prior behavior; no authorization, adapter flags or delivery path changes. Engine/Channels guides updated. Smaller component/LiveView tests reproduce the full failure/recovery lifecycle; no new browser E2E authored. Existing E2E applicability check in progress because workflow lists SMTP settings under execution triggers.

Final isolated cross-boundary regression run: 315 passed (3 properties, 312 tests) across ten bridge, Engine, component and LiveView files. mix q passed on final code; git diff --check clean. Existing system_config/channels Chromium E2E execution attempted through Context Mode but blocked before launch: test/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright is missing (exit 127). No dependencies installed or browser tests authored. Keep this issue in_progress for remaining validation; implementation is complete. mix precommit remains stopped by user instruction; coverage awaits review approval.
